name: Quiz Countdown
description: A loud trivia Short on a bright orange striped background: a white question card, four answer pills with letter badges, a white timer ring that drains around a big countdown number, then a green reveal with confetti. The question card pops in, the four answers slide in one by one, the ring drains while the number counts down with a tick each second, then the right answer flashes green with confetti while the others fade. A one-line fact explains the answer and the next question is teased.
best_use_cases: Trivia questions with a countdown timer
Quiz Shorts with a reveal and a fact
